title: Ethanol Transfer Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Download the provided protocol file from the source link.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Open the OT App and upload the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Arrange deck layout
steps.instruction: Place labware on the robot deck as follows: Slot 1 – USA Scientific 12‑Well Reservoir containing ethanol; Slot 3 – Opentrons 20 µL tip rack; Slot 4 – Opentrons Magnetic Module with a NEST 96‑Well Plate.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, perform calibration of the deck, all labware, the tip rack, and the pipette according to the standard calibration workflow.

steps.title: Run first incubation and ethanol removal
steps.instruction: Start the protocol. The robot will incubate the plate on the Magnetic Module for 5 minutes, then aspirate and dispense 150 µL of ethanol from each well using the 20 µL tips.

steps.title: Manual centrifugation step
steps.instruction: When prompted, pause the run, carefully remove the plate from the robot, place it in a centrifuge and spin as required, then return the plate to the Magnetic Module.

steps.title: Second incubation and transfer
steps.instruction: After the plate is replaced, the protocol will perform a second incubation (duration defined in the script) followed by a second liquid transfer as programmed.

steps.title: Complete run
steps.instruction: Allow the protocol to finish, then press “Run” to end the procedure.
